a terminal block symbol
TERMINAL BLOCK: Symbol=TB_Square (TB-TB_Square if 2 terminals). Tag = the TB-# label (e.g. TB-3), goes in S/D Tag 1. Terminals = the numbered points -> Term 1=1, Term 2=2, ...
normally-open contact
CONTACT NO: symbol=Contact_NO_L/_R. Relay contacts tagged R# (e.g. R2). Terms are the numbered points. Example: Contact NO, tag R2, Term 1=9, Term 2=10.
